annotations.count_cue: 8 canonical-division containers, each wrapping a run of >=2 consecutive books of one literary genre: Law (5), Historical (OT historical books incl. the deuterocanonical Tobias/Judith), Wisdom-poetry, Prophets-Major, Prophets-Minor, a SECOND Historical run for the Machabees (which follow the prophets in Vulgate order and so form a separate contiguous run), Gospels, and Epistles (incl. the Apocalypse). A lone-genre run (Acts, between the Gospels and Epistles) carries its genre on the book itself rather than spawning a container span-identical to it. Counted by identity — the Bible layout emits `genre_division` natively, so there is no PROXY entry.

annotations.note: Secondary content-type grouping layer overlaid on the book structure (reported, not rated), mirroring the `book` annotation. Deuterocanonical books additionally carry a parallel `apocrypha` flag in book.metadata — a flag, not a division, since the section tree is strict single-parent and a book cannot sit inside both a genre and an apocrypha container.

map_status: complete 2026-06-22: full materialized map = 9129 elements. Name lines and editorial apparatus are now split: `header` (1438 = 2 testament dividers + 73 canonical book names + 1363 chapter names) and `heading` (1434 = 73 book summaries + 1361 chapter arguments); legacy `chapter_heading` retired in this work's map. Still includes per-chapter `section` spans (1363) and the inline `footnotes` carve (1758) so `chapter` = verse content only (3039).
